data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's claims reserves at 1 January 2018 were $701.3m (gross). The year included a net deterioration in prior-year claims of $10.701m (net), driven by adverse development and IBNR changes, and was materially affected by several large events (notably the Lrssen shipyard fire, California wildfires and Typhoon Jebi). The accounts are distorted by a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) acquisition (Chaucer Syndicate 6124 motor run-off) which added substantial gross reserves in 2018 and limits the reliability of deriving an aggregate gross prior-year movement from the development triangle; consequently no single gross prior-year strengthening/release figure is reported in the notes.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a deterioration of ($10,701,262) in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2017: deterioration $9,889,984).
The deterioration comprises net claims including the change in claims incurred but not reported ('IBNR').
The Syndicate entered into a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transaction with Chaucer Syndicate 6124 on 15th February 2018.
This was illustrated most starkly by Lrssen in Hull where a 146 metre mega yacht in its final stage of construction was destroyed by fire.
Californian Wildfires also impacted the Syndicate heavily, contributing a further $20m.
Typhoon Jebi caused extensive property damage when it made landfall in September as the strongest Typhoon to strike Japan in 25 years costing the Syndicate an estimated $10m.
data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year reserve movement (aggregate) is not explicitly stated in gross terms in the notes; only a net prior-year deterioration ($10.701m) is explicitly described. The gross claims development triangle is distorted by a Reinsurance to Close (RITC) from Chaucer Syndicate 6124 (motor run-off) which added substantial gross reserves in 2018; because of the RITC distortion and the absence of an explicit gross prior-year movement line, a reliable gross prior-year development figure cannot be calculated from the provided data. Many event impacts are stated on a net basis in the report.
